title: Run dependency hygiene pass and prune stale references
description:
Problem: app dependency surface includes candidate stale references (for example Nerdbank.MessagePack) that may no longer be needed.

Desired outcome: reduce dependency footprint and update governance around dependency introduction/removal.

Scope:
- In scope: identify unused package references, remove safe candidates, and document retained optional dependencies.
- Out of scope: replacing active core dependencies used by product features.

Acceptance criteria:
- Candidate unused dependencies are removed or explicitly justified.
- Build and test validation remains green after changes.
- Dependency review notes are captured in linked pages/tasks.

Validation:
- Build app/tests and run targeted suites impacted by removed packages.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from F-005 with explicit validation gate before dependency removal.
